# Convergence: current local models for the memory and retrieval stack (2026-09-25)

Trigger: the user asked why the stack still runs stale models. The retrieval layer used the defaults
that came with the two systems:
- ai-memory: Qwen3-Embedding-4B (2025-06-05);
- agentmemory: all-MiniLM-L6-v2 (2021) and the ms-marco-MiniLM cross-encoder (2021).

These were never re-screened against current leaderboards.

Lanes. Both were blind, and each saw only `sota-models-packet.md`:

| Lane | Output | Tool use | Usage |
|---|---|---|---|
| Codex GPT-6 Astra | `sota-models-codex.md` | 30 web searches | 3,179,978 input tokens (3,044,352 cached); 10,544 output tokens |
| Claude Opus 5.5 | `sota-models-claude.md` | 130 tool uses | 414,369 subagent tokens |

## Agreement

- **Embedding.** Both lanes rank NVIDIA **Nemotron-3-Embed-8B** first and **Nemotron-3-Embed-1B**
  second. Both were released 2026-07-16 under OpenMDW-1.1, with 32,768-token inputs.
- **Reranking.** **ettin-reranker-400m-v1** (Sentence Transformers, 2026-05-19, Apache-2.0)
  is on both lists.
- **Memory LLM.** Both keep Qwen3.5-9B as the control.
- **Risks both lanes flag.**
  - Nemotron-3-Embed is bidirectional, so the llama.cpp and GGUF conversions are unofficial.
    An LM Studio bug report also shows wrong output dimensions.
  - Quantized accuracy and local speed are unverified.
  - The specialised rerankers need adapters: neither memory system accepts an arbitrary
    cross-encoder.

## Independent evidence (Claude lane)

This is LMEB, the Long-horizon Memory Embedding Benchmark (MTEB leaderboard API, snapshot
2026-09-24), run by its authors in results PRs #600 and #617. Scores for its LongMemEval task
(nDCG@10):

| Model | Score |
|---|---|
| Nemotron-3-Embed-8B | 85.70 |
| Nemotron-3-Embed-1B | 81.58 |
| Qwen3-Embedding-8B | 77.66 |
| Qwen3-Embedding-0.6B | 73.08 |
| harrier-oss-v1-0.6b | 72.46 |
| all-MiniLM-L6-v2 | 67.94 |
| **Qwen3-Embedding-4B (production)** | **50.21** |

The production embedder is the weakest model listed on that task.

## Divergence

| Role | Codex only | Claude only |
|---|---|---|
| Embedding, third place | Qwen3-Embedding-8B, as control | harrier-oss-v1-0.6b (Microsoft, MIT) |
| Reranking | MemReranker-4B (memory-trained, 2026-04-27); Jina Reranker v3.5 (CC-BY-NC-4.0) | Qwen3-Reranker-4B (2025-06); KaLM-Reranker-V1-Small (2026-06/08) |
| Memory LLM | LFM2.5-2.6B (Liquid, 2026-08-04, LFM1.0 licence); MemReader-4B-thinking (consolidation only) | Qwen3.6-35B-A3B (2026-04-16); Nemotron 3.5 Lightning 30B-A3B (2026-08-11) |

## Resolution

No adjudication is needed, because the question is which models to measure, not which one wins.
The union goes to measurement under amendment A15, and the measured results decide, with these
exceptions:
- **Excluded: Jina Reranker v3.5.** Its non-commercial licence conflicts with the trading lane.
- **Measured but not deployable yet: LFM2.5-2.6B.** Its custom LFM1.0 licence needs review
  before any production use.
- **Out of scope: MemReader-4B-thinking.** It is a consolidation model, and a retrieval
  benchmark cannot measure it.

# Convergence: memory systems to benchmark against ai-memory (2026-09-25)

**Trigger.** The user asked why ai-memory is "the best". It never was. The catalog verdict for the
memory layer is `keep_but_compare`, and nine alternatives were reviewed from source only. Measured
recall_all@5 on the full track:

| System | recall_all@5 |
|---|---|
| agentmemory with MiniLM | 0.821 |
| Dense retrieval | 0.753 |
| BM25 | 0.747 |
| ai-memory with MiniLM | 0.496 |
| ai-memory, FTS only | 0.400 |

**Lanes.** Both were blind and saw only `memory-systems-packet.md`:

| Lane | Output | Work | Tokens |
|---|---|---|---|
| Codex GPT-6 Astra | `memory-systems-codex.md` | 16 web_search calls | 2,511,644 input (2,394,880 cached), 10,597 output |
| Claude Opus 5.5 | `memory-systems-claude.md` | 129 tool uses | 303,563 |

## Agreement

- **Hindsight** (vectorize-io, MIT, v0.10.1, 2026-09-21) is ranked 1st by Codex and 2nd by Claude.
  - It has the strongest vendor QA claims: LongMemEval-S 91.4% with Gemini-3 (paper 2025-12), and
    83.6% with gpt-oss-20b.
  - It has hooks for Claude Code and Codex, and runs local models.
  - Cost: an LLM extracts facts on every retain.
- **Mem0 OSS** (Apache-2.0, v2.2.0, 2026-09-23) is ranked 4th by both lanes.
  - Its platform and OSS scores differ, and some of its optimizations are platform-only.
  - Local capture needs glue code.
- **Both lanes warn** that vendor QA numbers use different answer and judge models, so they cannot
  be compared with each other or with our retrieval metric. Only measurement on the same protocol
  settles the question.

## Evidence that uses our exact metric (recall_all@5, LongMemEval-S cleaned)

| System | Score | Source | Caveats |
|---|---|---|---|
| Attemory | 96.38% on 470 questions, with local Qwen3.5-9B | Codex lane; vendor benchmark file, undated | The core ships as a prebuilt SDK, so full source and licence coverage are unverified. |
| MemPalace, raw mode | 0.857 on 470 questions | Claude lane re-scored the vendor's committed per-question logs | MiniLM over user-turn text only; this mode bypasses the palace code. |
| MemPalace, hybrid v4 | 0.887 on 424 held-out questions | Same | This mode was tuned on LongMemEval. |
| GBrain | 95.53% "all sessions within five chunks" | Codex lane | Different unit: five chunks is not five sessions. It uses hosted OpenAI and Voyage models. |

## Divergence

| Codex only | Claude only |
|---|---|
| Attemory (#2); GBrain (#3); OpenViking (#5, AGPL) | MemPalace (#1); QMD (#3, already installed); Honcho (#5, AGPL, Postgres + Redis + worker) |

## Resolution: measure the union, subject to feasibility gates (amendment A16)

- **Measure, cheap and local:**
  - MemPalace, in raw and palace (production) modes. Hybrid v4 is reported as tuned and makes no
    decision.
  - QMD.
  - GBrain, with local providers only.
- **Measure, with LLM extraction and subject to cost:** Hindsight and Mem0 OSS, each with one local
  model.
- **Measure only after a gate:** Attemory, once its prebuilt core's source and licence are
  verified.
- **Not measured:**
  - Honcho: AGPL, heavy, and its embedder can silently fall back to OpenAI.
  - OpenViking: AGPL, and no LongMemEval score was found.
  - Graphiti/Zep, Supermemory (engine source not found), Letta (server retired), Cognee, Basic
    Memory, claude-mem and MemOS: none was on either shortlist.
- **Realism check (Claude lane):** 50-session haystacks are easy. A pooled-store run is recommended
  as a secondary stress test.
- **Fit caveat:** LongMemEval-S tests chat recall. LongMemEval-V2 (2026-05) tests agent
  trajectories.

## Rules applied

- **Evidence classes.**
  - **NCE** (native_cli_execution): measured in our LongMemEval-S harness. These are Mac runs on

- **Ceiling for challengers.** A row can reach `adopt_within_scope` only with two things: NCE in our
  harness, and a pass of the memory-lane acceptance. That acceptance reads: "An explicit durable
  decision is retrievable in its intended scope with cross-scope negatives". Its next gate reads:
  "Recovery without importing unrelated histories or another host's credential store". No
  challenger has both, so the most any challenger gets is `trial`.
- **Replacing production.** A challenger must beat both C3 and C4 (A14 intersection–union). Holm
  runs within each family at α = 0.0333, and the gain must be significant and at least +5 pp
  (A2, A15.2).

## 1. Judge outcomes mapped through the key

All nine judges were blind GPT-6 Sol runs through `codex exec`, read-only and working from the
file alone. All nine exited with code 0.

The key defines three orders:
- **a:** A is the Codex lane, listed first.
- **b:** A is the Claude lane, listed first.
- **c:** A is the Codex lane, but B (Claude) is listed first.

- **Pins.** Use the upstream official artifact, pinned by version and digest. Never use

  `CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR` and `CODEX_HOME` pointing into the trial directory. Services bind to
  loopback, and each has its own data directory.
- **Credentials.** Sign in natively and passwordlessly on that host. Never copy another host's
  credential store. Production configuration on the Mac is never edited.
- **Protocol.** A16 must be written and committed in `PREREGISTRATION.md` before any
  memory-system arm runs. A15.2 reserves α = 0.0167 for it, and its arms must be named before
  their first run.
